state_delta_contract.update_rule: If reward_calc.reward_result.reward >= 0.75 and run1_receipt.policy_compliant is true and run1_receipt.verified_success is true, compile exactly one persisted reflex entry for the mission pattern and set the route preference to prefer_reflex.
